# Copilot instructions

Pointer file only. All guidance for coding agents in this repository lives in
[`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root.

**Read `AGENTS.md` before making any change**, and treat its contents as part of
these instructions. It covers the architecture, the invariants to preserve, how
to add a page or a backend api, the dev/quality/deploy commands (the `pswamp` CLI), and the CI rules.

Put new guidance in `AGENTS.md`, never in this file.
